{{Top}}
The '''Minister of State''' led the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Ministry of State (Alliance)|Ministry of State]]. The Minister of State was the most important post in the [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|Alliance Cabinet]]. In the event of the death or impeachment of the sitting [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]], the Minister of State was to take temporary command of the government until elections were held.
